API paths are relative to the panel URL. Requests and responses use JSON.
После входа сохраняйте cookie xray_sessi: Keep the xray_session cookie after login. Read csrf from GET /api/state and send it in X-CSRF-Token for protected POST requests.
Ошибки возвращают поле error. Accept-Lan: Errors return an error field. Accept-Language: en selects English; Russian is the default. Status codes 400, 401, 403, 429 and 503 mean invalid input, missing session, forbidden access, rate limit and unavailable operation.
Версия, полный SHA исходников и ссылка н: Version, full source SHA and tag link. No login required.
Состояние шлюза, профили, списки, статис: Gateway state, profiles, lists, statistics, current user and CSRF. Only administrators receive users. Passwords and VLESS keys are omitted.
Сессия действует 12 часов. Панель хранит: Sessions last 12 hours. The panel stores sessions encrypted and checks the account revision on each request. Password or role changes revoke earlier sessions.
Если у пользователя включена 2FA, первый: With 2FA enabled, the first request returns a challenge without a cookie. Submit challenge and code in the second request. An unfinished login expires after three minutes.
Проверка логина и пароля. При успехе без: Verify username and password. Sets the cookie on success without 2FA.
Завершает вход по одноразовому коду или: Complete login with a TOTP or recovery code.
Отзывает текущую сессию и закрывает её т: Revoke the current session and close its RouterOS terminal.
Каждый профиль имеет собственный приорит: Each profile has its own priority from 1 to 1000. Lower numbers win among enabled, available profiles. Configuration changes validate and restart Xray.
Для подписки сначала получите кандидатов: Preview a subscription to obtain candidates. Its selection token belongs to the session and lasts five minutes. Add accepts several profiles; replacement accepts one. Reimport updates matching records in that subscription group.
Загружает VLESS-подписку и возвращает to: Download a VLESS subscription and return token, profiles, skipped and group. Candidates include ID, name, address, port, transport and security.
Добавляет профиль. Для подписки передайт: Add a profile. For subscriptions, send the token, selected IDs and individual names and priorities. Read revision from /api/state.
Accepts the profile ID and current revision. An empty uri preserves the connection; edit name, priority and enabled separately.
Delete a profile by ID and revision.
Сбрасывает только число проверок и успеш: Reset total and successful probe counts. Keep traffic counters.
Список принимает IPv4, IPv6, CIDR и доме: Lists accept IPv4, IPv6, CIDR and domain names. Separate entries with whitespace, commas, semicolons or newlines. The panel removes duplicates and leaves domain resolution to RouterOS.
Редактирование и удаление используют ver: Editing and deletion use the list version. Deletion first removes that list’s RouterOS resources; a failed cleanup keeps the panel record.
Create a list and return list.
Обновляет имя и содержимое своего списка: Update the name and entries of one list.
Запускает очистку RouterOS и удаление сп: Start RouterOS cleanup and list deletion. Returns 202 with a job ID; read the RouterOS job log.
Настройте SSH-доступ и закрепите отпечат: Configure SSH and pin the host key fingerprint. The panel stores secrets encrypted. Blank secret fields preserve existing credentials when saving the same connection.
Параметры SSH без пароля и приватного кл: SSH settings without the password or private key; configured and passphrase_set describe saved credentials.
Получает отпечаток для проверки админист: Read a host fingerprint for administrator verification.
Проверяет и сохраняет SSH-подключение. Д: Verify and save SSH access. Key authentication uses private_key and optional passphrase; password authentication uses password.
Генерирует скрипт без выполнения. Можно: Generate a script without executing it. Supply list_id or destinations, source, interface and local_networks.
Устанавливает или заменяет список. Возвр: Install or replace a list. Returns 202 with a job ID.
Возвращает status, logs и следующий curs: Return status, logs and the next cursor. States: queued, running, done, error.
Терминал использует SSH PTY и связан с п: The terminal uses SSH PTY and belongs to the user and session. Raw output is base64-encoded. Idle sessions close after five minutes; maximum lifetime is one hour.
Open a terminal and return its ID.
Читает data, cursor и closed. data нужно: Read data, cursor and closed. Decode data from base64.
Отправляет текст, управляющие символы и: Send text, control characters and terminal responses.
Close a connection belonging to the current session.
Пароли содержат от 8 до 1024 символов. О: Passwords contain 8 to 1024 characters. Regular users manage their own accounts but cannot change shared settings, profiles, lists or RouterOS access.
Аватар передаётся в base64, допускаются: Upload avatars as base64 PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. An empty string removes the avatar. The panel returns the TOTP secret only during setup and recovery codes only when generated.
Меняет display_name и preferences своей: Change the current account’s display_name and preferences.
Save or remove the current avatar.
Change the password after verifying the current password.
Создаёт временный секрет и URI настройки: Create a pending secret and provisioning URI after password verification.
PNG QR code for pending enrollment.
Включает TOTP и выдаёт коды восстановлен: Enable TOTP and issue recovery codes.
Отключает TOTP после проверки пароля и к: Disable TOTP after verifying password and code.
Создаёт пользователя с role admin или op: Create an account with role admin or operator.
Меняет пользователя по id и revision. Пу: Edit an account by ID and revision. A blank password preserves the current password.
Удаляет пользователя. Панель защищает по: Delete an account. The panel protects the last administrator and prevents self-deletion.
GET /api/state содержит settings и их re: GET /api/state includes settings and their revision. Send only the fields to change and the current revision. Route settings feed RouterOS operations; saved values survive restarts.
Настраивает gateway, host, source, inter: Set gateway, host, source, interface, local_networks, probe_url, check_interval, fail_threshold and recover_threshold.
Проверка выбирает более новую версию с о: Checks select a newer version with published Gateway and Updater images. Installation pins image digests, backs up data, recreates the Compose services and rolls back if verification fails.
Автоустановка по умолчанию отключена, пе: Automatic installation is off by default; periodic checks are on. Configure the updater service, which alone receives the Docker socket. Write operations return 503 during installation.
Текущая и доступная версии, время провер: Current and available versions, check time, updater availability and job status. Settings and detailed logs require an administrator.
Запускает проверку в фоне и возвращает 2: Start a background check and return 202. Checks are limited to once per minute.
Период проверки: от 1 до 168 часов. auto: Check interval: 1 to 168 hours. auto_install controls automatic installation.
Устанавливает доступный tag из результат: Install the available tag returned by a check. Returns 202 with the job ID; read /api/updates for progress.
Установлена актуальная версия: The current version is up to date
